description: This source file defines the DefaultTypeFilter class, which implements ITypeNameFilter. It provides logic to determine whether certain type names and assembly names should be allowed, mainly for exception and system types in the Orleans.Serialization library.

classes.name: DefaultTypeFilter
classes.description: Implements ITypeNameFilter to allow certain exception and system types, as well as types from Orleans.Serialization, based on name patterns and assembly name.

methods.name: IsTypeNameAllowed
methods.description: Determines if a given type and assembly name should be allowed, returning true, false, or null based on internal rules.
